_comment: Watchlist predictions and their outcomes, surfaced in the app per step 13.
WATCHLIST.md was written BEFORE any live response was seen, deliberately, so its
predictions would be falsifiable. WATCHLIST-RESULTS.md records what happened.
This file is the machine-readable extract. It carries CONFIRMED and REFUTED alike:
a watchlist that shows only its hits is an advertisement, and the whole value of
writing predictions down first is destroyed by reporting them selectively.
P13 governs additions: a prediction is checked against the tree before it is
recorded as an outcome, never assumed because several sessions repeated it.

predictions.subject: France
predictions.note: The one that matters most for the other direction: the prediction was that a rule WOULD fire, and it did, on the exact label predicted. The rules work where they are supposed to work.

predictions.subject: Switzerland
predictions.predicted: undetermined; may need a collective rule
predictions.note: Returns an office where a person is expected — the collective-executive case the rules deliberately refuse rather than guess at.

predictions.subject: Andorra
predictions.predicted: undetermined; two co-princes, one a foreign head of state

predictions.subject: Saudi Arabia
predictions.predicted: rule 4 — king is also prime minister
predictions.note: The first attempt returned HTTP 502. That was transient, not a refutation — re-run, the same person holds both offices exactly as predicted. Recorded because a transport failure read as a data answer is the confusion this project keeps having to unpick.
